subject: Aligned roles & cadence for MSA/DPA/order-form sequencing — Vitalsync
messages:
From: Leah Sanders <leah.sanders@vitalsync.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vitalsync.io>
Date: Mon, Apr 20, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Sequencing question: MSA/DPA/Order form dependencies & timeline

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week; really helpful. Procurement has a couple of sequencing constraints we need to bake into the mutual action plan before we can commit to a pilot timeline. Short version: we need clarity on the contract gating order (MSA vs DPA vs order form), expected review windows, and the evaluation acceptance criteria that Procurement will require before they release PO/budget.

Specific asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Vitalsync needs the DPA fully executed before the order form is signed, or if we can sign the order form with a DPA commitment (final DPA within X days)?
- Procurement requests SOC 2 attestation (or recent SOC 2 report) and a short DPA checklist — can you provide both?
- We plan a 2-week evaluation (pilot). What evidence will Redwood need to mark it "accepted"?

Attaching our internal procurement checklist and example order form for reference.

Leah
Leah Sanders
Director of Procurement, Vitalsync
leah.sanders@vitalsync.io
Attachments: procurement_checklist_vitalsync.xlsx (spreadsheet), example_orderform.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Sanders <leah.sanders@vitalsync.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 21, 2026 at 10:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Sequencing question: MSA/DPA/Order form dependencies & timeline

Leah — thanks for the clear asks, very helpful. I sketched a recommended sequencing and owner matrix below that aligns with Redwood's standard cadence but allows a short parallel path so you can sign the order form within your procurement window. Putting this in the MAP draft (attached) but calling out the key points here so we can confirm quickly.

Proposed sequencing (high-level):
1) Evaluation & pilot (2 weeks) — tech/SE-led; acceptance criteria documented in MAP; Redwood provides hosted demo + evaluation credits. Owner: Vanessa.
2) Legal redline window (MSA) — concurrent with pilot; Redwood legal (Karthik) reviews Vitalsync redlines. Target: turnaround 3 business days after receipt. Owner: Karthik.
3) DPA checklist/negotiation — procurement/legal parallel path; we can accept an "order form with DPA commitment" (signature triggers execution of order form) provided there is a firm DPA finalization date (we typically require DPA execution before production). Owner: Karthik + Procurement.
4) Order form signature — allowed to proceed if MSA redlines are agreed in principle and DPA has committed timeline; final signature once DPA complete if production access is needed. Owner: Mina / Procurement.

Key dates (please confirm):
- Draft MAP + artifacts sent: 2026-04-21 (today).
- Vitalsync to return MSA redlines: by 2026-04-29 (EOW).
- DPA checklist response from Vitalsync procurement: by 2026-04-23.
- Pilot window: 2026-04-26 through 2026-05-09.
- Go/No-go checkpoint and decision: 2026-05-04.

Attachments included: MAP_draft_vitalsync.docx, MSA_v1_redline.pdf, DPA_req_list.xlsx.

Action items for Vitalsync:
- Procurement: confirm DPA timing commitment (reply to this thread).
- Legal/contact counsel: provide preferred counsel contact and any must-have DPA clauses.
- SE/team: confirm acceptance criteria for pilot (list out 3 items).

If that sequencing works we can lock these dates into a shared MAP and I will schedule the checkpoint meeting (05/04).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Sanders <leah.sanders@vitalsync.io>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@counselia.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 22, 2026 at 02:20 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Sequencing question: MSA/DPA/Order form dependencies & timeline

Leah / Mina — quick legal note from our side to make sure expectations are aligned. We are fine with the general sequencing Mina proposed, with one important constraint: Vitalsync must commit to a DPA execution timeline before we enable any production-level keys or data flows. Signing an order form for prepaid credits or evaluation-only access is fine earlier, but production access requires the executed DPA.

Priority DPA discussion points (short list):
- Data processing roles and subprocessors — we insist on transparent subprocessors list and prior notice for changes.
- Data retention and deletion obligations tied to order form term.
- Security commitments: SOC 2 attestation and incident notification windows (48 hours).
- Liability caps and indemnity carveouts related to regulated data — we can negotiate but need clarity early.

If you want to accelerate, we can provide our standard DPA template + a short redline with the SOC 2 reference; counsel (Tom Becker, cc'd) can receive Vitalsync's preferred wording and try to return a consolidated redline within 3 business days from receipt. Please share counsel contact if you have an outside counsel.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Attachments referenced: standard_DPA_template.pdf

Subject: Re: Sequencing question: MSA/DPA/Order form dependencies & timeline

Leah — quick confirmation from the SE/account side. The pilot acceptance criteria we propose (already in the MAP draft) are small, measurable items so procurement can see clear pass/fail outcomes. Summarized below: 

Pilot acceptance criteria (pass = all three met):
- Latency: average inference p95 below 600ms for 2k token sessions in your sample workload.
- Functionality: deterministic model outputs for 20 canonical prompts defined by your team (we'll include the prompt set in the MAP).
- Integration: successful delivery of logs and telemetry to your SIEM for two sample cases (security telemetry ok).

Support we'll provide during pilot:
- Hosted demo instance and evaluation credits (no production keys).
- Weekly syncs (30 mins) — cadence: Mon 10am PT during the pilot window.
- Shared Drive folder with MAP, acceptance artifacts, and evidence templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3vitalsync-map

If Procurement can confirm DPA commitment dates by EOW (2026-04-23) and legal gets us MSA redlines by 2026-04-29, we are aligned to start the pilot on 2026-04-26. I will create the 05/04 checkpoint invite once I see confirmation here.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
